Boot Barn provides equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national or ethnic origin, veteran or military status, disability, as well as any other protected status under the law.* *Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) \- Boot Barn will provide reasonable accommodations (such as a qualified sign language interpreter or other personal assistance) with the application process upon your request as required by applicable laws. If you have a disability and require assistance in this application process, please visit your nearest Boot Barn Store or Distribution Center or reach out to Human Resources at 1\-949\-453\-4400, Option 4\.* California Privacy Notice

jobs.title: BCG X Talent Sourcer
jobs.description: **Locations**: Chicago \| Brooklyn Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do As a BCG X Talent Sourcer you will support the identification and engagement of top talent for BCG. You’ll build foundational sourcing skills, develop an understanding of the consulting talent market, and work closely with recruiters and sourcers to help deliver high\-impact hires. You will play a vital role in bringing premier talent across distinct roles and functions into the organization, enabling BCG to deliver client solutions that have lasting impact on companies, industries, and society. * Build robust and high\-quality talent pipelines with a primary focus on technical talent, including AI\-focused roles (Forward Deployed AI Scientists, Forward Deployed AI Engineers) and broader tech and product roles (Product Managers, Solution Analysts, Data Analysts, Data Engineers, UX Designers) * Use a variety of sourcing methods (e.g., LinkedIn, Eightfold, social media) to identify pools of talent for unique, competitive, or difficult to fill roles * Gain a deep understanding of the talent landscape for roles; build a competitive intelligence knowledge base of companies and candidates residing within those companies * Collaborate closely and provide support for talent acquisition recruiters to identify top talent, by executing on desired sourcing strategy; maintain flexibility to provide support in other topic areas depending on evolving and changing needs * Work with Talent Sourcing Senior Manager to maintain clear understanding of all current and potential openings. Deliver the quality and quantity of candidates to support open requisitions within reasonable and requested time frames * Manage talent pool activity and share data\-centric updates with recruiters for broader communication with internal stakeholders * Perform initial contact and conduct preliminary screenings with candidates at the direction of the Talent Sourcing Senior Manager * Be flexible to engage in sourcing initiatives across BCG’s experienced and specialty roles as needed * Work as part of the broader Experienced and Specialty Talent team that includes multiple cohorts, led by a Talent Acquisition Senior Director What You'll Bring * A minimum of 3 years of talent sourcing experience, ideally gained in agency, professional services, or in\-house with an international organization * Proven experience sourcing technical talent (software/data engineers, data scientists, AI/ML roles) strongly preferred * Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent required * Excellent time and project management skills. You have clear systems and composure to deal with high\-volume recruiting, with a great attention to detail and accuracy * Strong intellectual curiosity. You’re eager to learn, ask questions, and deepen your understanding of talent markets, roles, and business context. * Creative and solutions\-oriented mindset. You approach challenges thoughtfully and proactively, looking for ways to improve outcomes and think beyond the obvious. * Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt both for audience * Naturally proactive, quality\-driven and an ownership mentality * Hands\-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, iCIMS and/or Eightfold a plus * Ability to travel up to 10% expected Who You'll Work With You will be based in BCG’s Chicago or Brooklyn offices, alongside at least one other member of the Experienced \& Specialty recruiting team. Additional info Format At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person work is essential to our culture, mentorship, and professional development. That's why we operate on a hybrid model, with the expectation that team members will be in the office 3 to 5 days per week. This role is designed for those who thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment and is not intended for remote or virtual work. Compensation Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, retirement contribution, and a market leading benefits package described below. The base salary range for this role begins at $73,000\.00 in our lowest cost geography and goes up to $100,667\.00 in our highest cost geography (USD). Your recruiting contact can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. This is an estimated range and specific base salaries within the range depend on various factors such as office location, experience, and skill set. It is not common for new BCG employees to be hired at the high\-end of the salary range. BCG regularly reviews its ranges to ensure market competitiveness. In addition to your base salary, your total compensation will include a discretionary bonus of up to 12% and a generous retirement contribution that starts at 5% and moves to 10% after 2 years. At BCG, we are committed to offering a comprehensive benefit program that includes everything our employees and their families need to be well and live life to the fullest. We pay the full cost of medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees – and their eligible family members.\* That’s zero dollars in premiums taken from employee paychecks. All of our plans provide best in class coverage: * Zero dollar ($0\) health insurance premiums for BCG employees, spouses, and children * Low $10 (USD) copays for trips to the doctor, urgent care visits and prescriptions for generic drugs * Dental coverage, including up to $5,000 in orthodontia benefits * Vision insurance with coverage for both glasses and contact lenses annually * Reimbursement for gym memberships and other fitness activities * Fully vested retirement contributions made annually, whether you contribute or not, plus the option for employees to make personal contributions to a 401(k) plan * Paid Parental Leave and other family benefits such as elective egg freezing, surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement * Generous paid time off including 12 holidays per year, an annual office closure between Christmas and New Years, and 15 vacation days per year (earned at 1\.25 days per month) * Paid sick time on an as needed basis * Employees, spouses, and children are covered at no cost. Employees share in the cost of domestic partner coverage. Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: **About Bounce...** ------------------- Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world, starting with the largest global luggage storage network in existence. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000\+ small business locations worldwide for hyper\-local short term baggage storage. With more locations globally than Burger King, and more locations in New York City than Starbucks, Bounce has served 3M\+ users and stored 10M\+ bags, and paid over $10M to small business. To achieve this, Bounce is a fast\-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high\-energy, close\-knit, and collaborative environment \- Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest\-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE) **About the role…** ------------------- We're looking for a Product Designer to join our design team. You'll work across our consumer product (web and mobile), contributing to the full design process: from early discovery and ideation through to polished, shipping\-ready UI. You'll be embedded in a cross\-functional pod alongside product managers, and engineers with mentorship from senior designers. This is an ideal role for someone who's sharp, curious, and ready to grow fast. You won't just be executing tasks \- you'll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and develop a strong design voice of your own. **Where you come in...** ------------------------ **Design \& Craft** * Use Figma and AI tools to communicate and validate design decisions * Contribute to the UX of Bounce's consumer\-facing product across web and mobile * Help maintain and extend Bounce's design system, ensuring consistency across surfaces **Research \& Discovery** * Participate in user interviews, usability tests, and research sessions * Understand how users interact with current flows and where pain points exist through quantitative and qualitative data * Contribute to competitive research and stay curious about how leading consumer products solve similar problems **Collaboration** * Work closely with product managers to understand problem framing, constraints, and success metrics before jumping into design * Partner with engineers to understand technical constraints and ensure design feasibility * Present your work in design jam sessions, and articulate the reasoning behind your decisions **Your profile...** ------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in product design * A portfolio that demonstrates UX thinking \- not just polished visuals * Solid working knowledge of Figma * A genuine interest in user\-centred design: you think about the person using the product before you think about the pixels * Strong attention to detail \- you notice when something is 2px off, and you care * Clear communicator who can explain design decisions without jargon * Comfortable receiving feedback and using it to improve your work, quickly

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description: Our Company: BrightSpring Health Services Overview: Top level contributor and technical expert in Windows, Linux/Unix, and virtualization. The System Administrator understands other contributing technologies required to deliver services on all platforms. The System Administrator will be responsible for the overall integration and integrity of the enterprise\-wide network including the planning, design, installation, maintenance, management, and security of the Windows, Unix and Linux systems. Responsibilities: * Performs server administration tasks, including group policies, print services, research event log warnings and errors, and resource monitoring, ensuring system architecture components work together seamlessly * Handles first level on\-call rotation for Systems Engineering team * Documents configurations, instructional procedures, change management records * Works with hardware and software vendors, including support calls and maintenance performed by vendor engineers * Monitors datacenter health using preexisting management tools and respond to hardware issues as they arise; jobs.title: Senior Roadway Project Manager
jobs.description: For more than a century, Burgess \& Niple has helped communities strengthen the infrastructure that supports everyday life. Our teams combine technical expertise with a commitment to improving quality of life, safety and sustainability. At B\&N, that legacy shapes meaningful careers. You will collaborate on projects that make a difference, grow alongside experienced teams and contribute to work that has lasting impact. Join our nationally recognized team of civil engineering professionals and take ownership of a diverse and rewarding portfolio of transportation projects. As a Senior Roadway Project Manager, you'll lead multidisciplinary teams through the full lifecycle of highway, roadway, and active transportation projects, from planning and design through construction, while serving as the trusted point of contact for state DOTs, counties, and municipalities. This role places you at the intersection of technical leadership and client partnership, where your ability to drive project delivery, manage budgets and schedules, and build lasting relationships is as important as your engineering expertise. You'll also play a meaningful role in mentoring the next generation of engineers and contributing to the growth of our transportation practice, with clear opportunity to advance within the firm. **What You'll Do** * Manage the planning, design, and delivery of transportation infrastructure projects for public agency clients including state DOTs, counties, and municipalities * Oversee design execution while monitoring key performance indications including project scope, schedule, and budget, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to contract requirements * Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams across internal disciplines and subconsultants to achieve integrated, high\-quality deliverables * Review and approve highway, roadway, bicycle, and pedestrian design work products including plans, cost estimates, and technical reports * Serve as the primary client point of contact, managing day\-to\-day communication and fostering long\-term client relationships and delivering solutions that meet and exceed expectations * Represent the firm at client meetings, public involvement events, and professional organizations such as APWA and ASCE * Provide mentorship, training, and technical guidance to staff * Support business development through proposal development, scoping, fee negotiation, and client pursuits **Skills \& Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science degree in Civil Engineering or related field from an ABET\-accredited program * Professional Engineer (PE) registration in the state of employment, or ability to be registered with reciprocity * 10\+ years of related roadway design experience for state and municipal transportation clients * Expertise in Microsoft Office Suite, MicroStation or OpenRoads * Adaptable and self\-motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset as well as a proactive approach to problem solving * Servant leader committed to fostering collaboration, innovation, and excellence while developing others **Learn More** To learn more about B\&N, our culture and what we offer, visit: www.burgessniple.com/careers/perks\-culture **Burgess \& Niple is an Equal Opportunity Employer** All qualified protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description: Location : Seattle Team : Technology Employment Type : Regular Job Code : A230840 Responsibilities **About the Team:** Data AML is ByteDance's Machine Learning mid\-platform, providing training and inference systems for recommendation, advertising, CV, speech, and NLP for businesses such as Douyin. It provides powerful Machine Learning computing power to internal business units within the company and conducts research on some general and innovative algorithms for issues in these businesses. At the same time, it also provides some core capabilities of Machine Learning and Recommender systems to external enterprise customers through Volcano Engine. In addition, AML also conducts some cutting\-edge research in fields such as Al for Science and scientific computing. **Responsibilities:** Optimizing resource efficiency in distributed orchestration and scheduling, through engineering means, enhances the scale of business/models supported per unit of computing power: * Use/secondarily develop distributed scheduling frameworks around the Kubernetes/Godel ecosystem, make reasonable selections in different business scenarios, and optimize scheduling strategies for cluster utilization/uniformity based on the characteristics of different scenarios; * Connect/extend AutoScaling for various models and business operations, as well as automatic parallelization tasks. Through the method of load modeling and analysis of different models, automatically optimize resource requests for models, optimize resource utilization efficiency at scale, and achieve global optimality; * Responsible for the preemption/eviction function of services with different priorities; responsible for the borrowing/mixed deployment docking work among different types of resources in different clusters; responsible for the scheduling/load adaptation in scenarios of multiple data centers, multiple regions, and multiple clouds; Build a training system architecture for next\-generation ultra\-large and ultra\-deep recommendation models: * Build a flexible and robust distributed training runtime around ultra\-large\-scale embedding and ultra\-large\-scale GPU synchronization training; Design and optimize distributed computing APis and runtime for future\-oriented research paradigms of recommended advertising models (e.g., RL/finetune/distillation); * Interface with the platform to optimize the diagnosability and usability of distributed training. Construct an online orchestration architecture for the next\-generation Recommender system: * Build a robust and stable distributed model inference architecture around the online training scenario of ultra\-large\-scale embeddings; * Optimize the usability of the online architecture of the recommended advertising model and the MLops process by integrating the research and experimental model of the business. Qualifications **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or similar field of study. * At least 5 years of experience with proficiency in at least one programming language among Go/Python in a Linux environment, with excellent hands\-on coding skills; * Familiar with some open\-source distributed scheduling frameworks, such as Kubernetes (K8S), Yarn (as well as the Big data frameworks Flink and MapReduce in the Hadoop ecosystem), Mesos, Celery, and has rich practical and development experience in Machine Learning systems; * Master the principles of distributed systems, and have participated in the design, development, and maintenance of large\-scale distributed systems; * Have excellent logical analysis skills, capable of reasonably abstracting and splitting business logic; * Have a strong sense of work responsibility, good learning ability, communication skills, and self\-motivation, and be able to respond and act quickly; * Have good work documentation habits, and timely write and update work processes and Technical Documentation as required. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiar with at least one mainstream Machine Learning framework (PyTorch / TensorFlow); * Have experience in one of the following areas: Al Infrastructure, HW/SW Co\-Design, High Performance Computing, ML Hardware Architecture (GPU, Accelerators, Networking); * Some experience in using/designing open\-source training orchestration systems, such as veRL, VLLM, Ray, TFX. coordination with Mechanical Design * Component selection and sizing — ACBs, MCCBs, contactors, relays, protection devices and busbar systems * Electrical calculations — fault level, load, cable sizing, busbar rating and thermal analysis * BOM generation and maintenance for all electrical designs * FAT procedure support and technical documentation preparation * Control logic, interlocking and communication interface design where required * Compliance verification against UL standards, NFPA, client specifications and internal quality procedures * Structured project documentation management electrical designs. * Design low voltage switchgear assemblies in accordance with applicable regional standards * Develop complete electrical schematic drawings using **EPLAN** or equivalent software, communication interfaces (Modbus, Profinet, and equivalents) where project requirements demand. **Documentation \& BOM Management** * Generate and maintain accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) for all electrical designs. * Support FAT procedures and prepare associated technical documentation to the required standard. * Maintain structured, organized project documentation throughout the design and delivery lifecycle. * Ensure all designs are compliant with IEC standards, client specifications and CEL's internal quality procedures, and that compliance is documented appropriately. with all functional, assembly, and project requirements. **Requirements** **Background** * An electrical engineer with hands\-on experience in **LV switchgear** design and schematic development — in electrical design within the switchgear or power distribution industry — required. * Proficiency in **EPLAN** (strongly preferred) or equivalent **electrical CAD software**. * Demonstrated ability to create detailed electrical schematics from client specifications. * Experience producing and reviewing General Arrangement drawings. * Strong technical interpretation skills for specifications and tender documents. * Good understanding of electrical component selection, sizing and integration across LV switchgear product families. * Familiarity with Switchgear, switchboards, RPPs and custom LV assemblies. * Familiar with **IEC Standards** * Design and safety standards: **OSHA, NFPA 70E, ANSI, IEEE, and NEMA** **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent— required. * Additional training in power systems or switchgear design is advantageous. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools including Excel and Word. **Skills \& Competencies** * Proficiency in EPLAN or equivalent electrical CAD platform * Design low voltage switchgear and power distribution assemblies in accordance with applicable UL standards including **UL891, UL62368\-1, UL508A, UL1008S, UL1008, UL67** * Understanding of electrical protection principles and power distribution systems * Ability to create detailed electrical schematics from specifications * Strong technical interpretation — reads and analyses specifications and tender documents accurately * Excellent attention to detail and a structured, methodical engineering approach * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines * Strong communication skills — works effectively across design, production and supplier teams * Self\-motivated and capable of working independently when required **Benefits** **Why Join CEL Critical Power?** **Join a Trusted Industry Leader – 42 Years of Excellence** CEL has been delivering high\-quality, bespoke power distribution solutions for jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: Manufacturing Engineer Job Summery The Manufacturing Engineer supports production by developing accurate fabrication drawings, manufacturing documentation, fixtures, tooling, and efficient production methods. This position is strongly focused on CAD drafting, fixture design, drawing control, bills of material, and translating engineering concepts into clear shop\-ready drawings. The Manufacturing Engineer works closely with production, quality, purchasing, project management, and customers to resolve drawing and fixturing issues, improve manufacturability, and ensure products are built according to specifications. Essential Duties and Responsibilities * Create detailed shop, fabrication, assembly, fixture, tooling, and installation drawings using CAD software. * Develop and revise 2D drawings and 3D models for manufactured components and assemblies. * Design welding fixtures, assembly fixtures, machining fixtures, jigs, templates, gauges, and workholding devices. * Evaluate existing fixtures and recommend improvements for safety, accuracy, repeatability, accessibility, and production efficiency. * Verify fixture dimensions, locating points, clamping methods, clearances, tolerances, and ease of use. * Work with welders, fitters, machinists, and supervisors to test and validate new fixtures before release to production. * Troubleshoot fixture\-related alignment, distortion, fit\-up, tolerance, and repeatability problems. * Modify fixtures when product designs, manufacturing processes, or production requirements change. * Maintain fixture drawings, identification numbers, revision records, bills of material, and maintenance documentation. * Prepare drawings for structural steel, piping, sheet metal, machined components, weldments, and other fabricated products. * Apply proper dimensions, tolerances, weld symbols, material specifications, and manufacturing notes. * Convert customer drawings, sketches, specifications, and field measurements into production\-ready drawings. * Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, manufacturability, and compliance with project requirements. * Create and maintain bills of material, cut lists, part lists, and material takeoffs. * Assign and maintain part numbers, drawing numbers, revision levels, and document\-control records. * Process drawing revisions and communicate changes to production, quality, purchasing, and project personnel. * Support CNC programming, nesting, machining, cutting, bending, fitting, welding, and assembly operations. * Work directly with shop personnel to answer drawing questions and resolve fabrication problems. * Verify that drawings and fixtures match available equipment, tooling, materials, and manufacturing capabilities. * Develop manufacturing instructions, routing sheets, setup instructions, process drawings, and work procedures. * Identify opportunities to reduce material waste, setup time, distortion, rework, and production costs. * Participate in design reviews, preproduction meetings, and continuous\-improvement activities. * Investigate dimensional or fabrication problems and develop practical corrective actions. * Coordinate with Quality Control to establish inspection points, critical dimensions, and fixture\-verification requirements. * Assist with estimating labor, material, machine time, tooling, and manufacturing requirements. * Maintain organized engineering, drawing, fixture, and tooling records. * Perform other engineering, drafting, and production\-support duties as assigned. Required Knowledge and Skills * Strong working knowledge of CAD drafting and 3D modeling. * Experience designing welding fixtures, fabrication fixtures, jigs, templates, gauges, and workholding devices. * Understanding of fixture locating principles, clamping methods, tolerance buildup, accessibility, repeatability, and part removal. * Ability to account for welding distortion, shrinkage, heat input, machining allowances, and assembly sequence when designing fixtures. * Ability to create clear and accurate fabrication, assembly, fixture, and tooling drawings. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, customer standards, and bills of material. * Knowledge of drafting standards, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, and dimensional inspection. * Understanding of welding symbols and common welding processes. * Knowledge of manufacturing processes such as cutting, forming, machining, fitting, welding, assembly, and coating. * Ability to perform material takeoffs and prepare accurate bills of material. * Understanding of drawing revisions and document\-control practices. * Strong mechanical aptitude and practical understanding of shop fabrication. * Ability to identify drawing, fixture, and manufacturing problems before production. * Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple drawings and projects while meeting production deadlines. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and manufacturing or ERP software. Education and Experience * Associate or bachelor’s degree in manufacturing engineering, mechanical engineering, drafting, engineering technology, or a related field. * Three or more years of CAD drafting, manufacturing engineering, fabrication, fixture design, or tooling experience preferred. * Extensive drafting, fixturing, and manufacturing experience may be considered instead of a degree. * Previous experience in a fabrication shop, machine shop, or manufacturing environment is strongly preferred. Preferred Software Experience * AutoCAD * SolidWorks * Inventor * Tekla * Plant 3D * Fusion 360 * Bluebeam * CNC nesting or programming software * ERP or material\-management systems Preferred Qualifications * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing welding, machining, assembly, and inspection fixtures. * Experience creating pipe fabrication, structural steel, weldment, sheet\-metal, or machining drawings. * Knowledge of AWS, ASME, AISC, or other applicable industry standards. * Experience with CNC plasma tables, laser cutting, press brakes, mills, lathes, or automated manufacturing equipment. * Familiarity with weld procedures, inspection requirements, material traceability, and distortion control. * Experience with fixture qualification, preventive maintenance, and revision control. * Lean manufacturing or continuous\-improvement experience. Physical Requirements * Ability to work in both office and manufacturing\-shop environments. * Ability to stand, walk, bend, climb stairs, and inspect work throughout the facility. * Ability to take field measurements and verify manufactured components, fixtures, and tooling. * Ability to lift and carry drawings, measuring equipment, tools, fixture components, or materials weighing up to 40 pounds. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment while working in production areas. Work Environment Work is performed in an office and active manufacturing environment. The employee may be exposed to welding, grinding, machining, noise, heat, dust, moving equipment, and changing shop conditions. Required personal protective equipment must be worn while entering designated production areas. Performance Expectations The Manufacturing Engineer is expected to produce accurate and timely drawings, develop safe and repeatable fixtures, maintain proper revision control, support production personnel, identify manufacturability concerns, and reduce setup time, rework, and production delays. Job Description Disclaimer This job description describes the primary duties and expectations of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties may be modified based on business needs, customer requirements, and the scope of fabrication performed. Pay: From $75,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Artificial Intelligence Engineer** **Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Information Security COSE Support** **Position: Full\-Time / Remote from Contractor Facility** Primary Work Location: Contractor facility within the United States; occasional coordinated support at VA Central Office, 811 Vermont Street NW, Washington, D.C. **JOIN OUR TEAM!** Caladwich is seeking a highly motivated, detail\-oriented Artificial Intelligence Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Information Security Cybersecurity Operations and Security Engineering (COSE) program. The selected professional will design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine\-learning capabilities that support VA cybersecurity architecture and engineering. This role applies production\-grade data science and software engineering practices while maintaining security, privacy, explainability, and Federal compliance. This position offers the opportunity to contribute directly to responsible use of AI to improve cybersecurity analysis, engineering, automation, and decision support across VA. The engineer turns operational needs into measurable AI solutions and integrates them safely into enterprise workflows. **WHO WE ARE:** Caladwich is a U.S.\-based Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and SBA 8(a) certified company providing professional services and mission support solutions to federal agencies worldwide. Our capabilities include Acquisition Support, Program Management, Logistics Support Services, Process Improvement, Asset Management, and Operational Support Services for DoD, DHS, VA, and GSA customers. As a Veteran\-owned company, our mission remains steadfast: **Integrity. Solutions. Results.** **Core Responsibilities** * Design, build, train, evaluate, deploy, and maintain machine\-learning models and AI systems in enterprise or Government environments. * Identify and implement AI\-enabled automation opportunities that reduce manual analysis, review cycle time, or rework without degrading security or quality. * Collect, clean, transform, analyze, and govern data used for modeling, testing, monitoring, and decision support. * Apply AI/ML engineering to security architecture, secure engineering, baseline management, risk analysis, and other COSE mission needs. * Collaborate with data scientists, software developers, security architects, engineers, and domain experts to define requirements and validate outcomes. * Develop production pipelines, interfaces, documentation, testing strategies, monitoring, and lifecycle controls for AI capabilities. * Assess model performance, reliability, drift, bias, explainability, privacy, security, and operational risk; document limitations and mitigations. * Integrate AI solutions with VA\-approved platforms, applications, data sources, and security controls in accordance with Federal and VA policy. **Operational Support** * Coordinate with VA stakeholders, technical teams, system owners, and other contractors to resolve issues and keep work aligned with VA priorities. * Develop, maintain, and submit accurate technical documentation, status information, and contract deliverables within required timeframes. * Apply VA security, privacy, accessibility, records\-management, and configuration\-management requirements to all work products. * Support risk, issue, dependency, schedule, and quality management activities, including corrective actions and continuous improvement. * Protect VA information and systems, use approved collaboration and remote\-access methods, and promptly report security or privacy concerns. * Participate in meetings, reviews, briefings, and occasional travel as directed and approved under the task order. * Prepare model documentation, data lineage, test evidence, deployment records, monitoring results, and decision\-ready technical briefings. * Support governance reviews, secure design assessments, incident response, vulnerability remediation, and ongoing model maintenance. jobs.title: Software Engineer (FDE / Platform) - Intern
jobs.description: **About Charta Health** ----------------------- In an industry where the focus should rightly be on delivering quality care to patients, healthcare providers remain burdened by the complexities of non\-clinical operations. Charta is changing that. We're building the operating system for modern healthcare organizations. Our AI platform streamlines critical workflows across revenue cycle, clinical operations, and administrative functions, helping providers and payers operate more efficiently and deliver better patient care. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Charta is on a mission to make every healthcare dollar accountable and every chart accurate, reimagining healthcare infrastructure from the ground up. ### **About the Opportunity** As a Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to production systems that power AI\-driven workflows for healthcare providers. This role blends core software engineering with forward deployed problem\-solving, giving you exposure to both building scalable internal platforms and developing practical, customer\-facing solutions. You will work directly with healthcare providers to understand their unique challenges and translate them into practical, data\-driven solutions using AI and machine learning. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, problem\-solving skills, and a strong customer\-centric mindset. You will thrive in a dynamic environment, rapidly deploying and iterating on solutions to deliver immediate value. What you'll do: * Collaborate closely with healthcare clients to understand their workflows and identify opportunities to leverage AI and machine learning * Customize and deploy Charta Health's AI\-driven platforms to address specific client needs * Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions, adapting to client feedback and evolving requirements * Break down complex projects into actionable steps and deliver results in ambiguous environments * Explore and integrate a wide range of AI/ML technologies, adapting to the diverse needs of our clients * Provide technical expertise and support to clients, ensuring successful deployment and adoption of our solutions * Work closely with our internal engineering team to provide feedback and contribute to product development * Design, build, and improve core platform systems that power analyses, data pipelines, and AI workflows across all customers * Contribute to scalable infrastructure and tooling that make deployments faster, more reliable, and easier to maintain * Help define internal engineering standards, abstractions, and reusable components that turn one\-off solutions into durable product capabilities * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in AI/ML and apply them alongside strong software engineering practices You'd be a great fit, if you have: * Proficiency and practical coding skills (Python and TypeScript), with a focus on delivering tangible results. * Solid understanding of common algorithms and data structures (e.g., arrays, linked lists, trees, hash tables) and practical ability to select and implement them appropriately. * Experience systematically isolating and diagnosing issues within code, leveraging debugging tools, log analysis, and stack traces effectively * Ability to efficiently navigate unfamiliar codebases, understand architectural patterns, and contribute quickly to existing projects. * Practical knowledge of writing and running unit and integration tests to verify code correctness. * Adaptability and the ability to quickly learn and master new technologies and concepts. * A priority on delivering business value over solving purely theoretical challenges. * A desire to explore a wide range of technologies and problems, rather than specializing in one area. * The ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and rapidly produce results. * The ability to excel at breaking down complex projects into actionable steps. * Resilience and resourcefulness, allowing you to overcome obstacles and find creative solutions. * Ambition and a desire for a high\-growth opportunity. * Strong emotional intelligence, excellent communication, and interpersonal skills. * Excitement about working with external customers and building strong relationships. * A genuine interest in the medical field and a passion for improving healthcare. * Completed at least your 2nd year of a Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical degree Nice\-to\-have: * Experience in a startup environment * Experience and/or demonstrated interest in healthcare * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering. * Experience with neural networks and machine learning * Degree in Computer Science / Engineering or related field What we offer: * Competitive salary * Team dinners and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Growth opportunities in a fast\-paced, innovative tech startup * Ongoing professional development and access to cutting\-edge AI and healthcare tools * Lively, in\-person work culture at our SF Headquarters or NYC office * $40–$60/hour based on experience **Our Commitment to Diversity** ------------------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Network Engineer II
jobs.description: **SALARY** $95,500 – $111,500 **POSITION SUMMARY** Under general supervision, installs, configures, administers, monitors, and maintains the Authority's enterprise network infrastructure. Provides advanced technical support for network systems by troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues; assists with network upgrades and infrastructure projects; and ensures the reliability, security, and performance of the Authority's network environment. **Qualifications** ------------------ **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Installs, configures, administers, and maintains enterprise network infrastructure. * Installs, configures, and supports routers, switches, wireless controllers, firewalls, and related network equipment. * Performs routine network maintenance, firmware updates, software upgrades, and system patches. * Monitors network performance and availability using enterprise monitoring tools. * Implements network configuration changes in accordance with Authority standards and best practices. * Performs performance tuning to improve network reliability and efficiency. * Troubleshoots network hardware, software, and connectivity issues. * Investigates and resolves complex network incidents escalated from lower support tiers. * Diagnoses routing, switching, wireless, firewall, and WAN connectivity issues. * Coordinates with telecommunications providers and hardware vendors to resolve service interruptions and equipment failures. * Documents problems and resolutions for future reference. * Assists with network infrastructure projects. * Assists in planning, testing, implementing, and validating network upgrades, installations, and technology refresh initiatives. * Coordinates installation activities to minimize operational impacts. * Verifies that network implementations comply with Authority standards. * Maintains network security and system integrity. * Administers firewall policies, access control lists, authentication services, and network security configurations. * Assists with implementing cybersecurity recommendations and security best practices. * Ensures network devices remain current with vendor\-supported firmware and security updates. * Develops and maintains technical documentation. * Documents network configurations, standards, procedures, diagrams, and topology information. * Maintains reports and documentation supporting network operations and management decision\-making. * Performs related duties as assigned. **MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES** Reporting to this position are the following jobs: Job Title * None **CHALLENGES** * Supporting a 24\-hour per day, 7\-day per week transit operation. * Maintaining reliable network connectivity across geographically dispersed facilities and transit operations. * Implementing infrastructure upgrades while minimizing service interruptions. * Keeping current with evolving networking technologies and cybersecurity best practices. **EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, plus three (3\) years of experience installing, configuring, administering, and maintaining enterprise network infrastructure, or an equivalent combination of education and experience relating to this position. * Experience supporting enterprise routing, switching, wireless, firewall, and WAN technologies required. * Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification or equivalent vendor certification required. * Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification preferred. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * Requires sitting for extended periods of time, standing, visual acumen, manual dexterity, and fingering for working with computer keyboards and other electronic equipment. * Requires stooping, bending, kneeling, standing, climbing, lifting, and walking on ballasted track and in subway tunnels. * May be required to lift and transport network equipment and materials weighing up to approximately 40 pounds. * May be required to work in confined spaces and access network equipment located in telecommunications rooms, equipment cabinets, and other operational environments. * Service Area Requirement: Exempt (Non\-Union) employees must live within the boundaries of the CTA Statutory Service Area either at the time of employment or within 6 months of beginning employment at CTA. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** * Detailed knowledge of TCP/IP networking architecture and principles. * Detailed knowledge of routing protocols including EIGRP, OSPF, and BGP. * Detailed knowledge of VLANs, spanning tree, link aggregation, DHCP, DNS, SNMP, SSH, FTP/SFTP, VRRP, and related networking protocols. * Detailed knowledge of enterprise systems monitoring and management tools including LogicMonitor, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco FMC, Cisco ASDM, SolarWinds, Cisco Secure Network Analytics, and Wireshark. * Detailed knowledge of Cisco, Fortinet, Nokia, and enterprise networking hardware. * Detailed knowledge of wireless networking technologies, Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, HP/Juniper Mist, and industrial wireless architectures. * Detailed knowledge of network security principles, TACACS\+, RADIUS, Cisco ISE, Cisco ASA/FTD, Fortinet Firewalls, and industry best practices. * Working knowledge of VXLAN/EVPN, multicast protocols, GRE/IPSec tunnels, policy\-based routing, load balancing, and SR\-MPLS. * Working knowledge of Python, Ansible, or other network automation technologies preferred. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Good written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with other employees, departments, vendors, and contractors. **WORKING CONDITIONS** * General office environment. * Required to travel to various locations within the CTA. * Occasionally works along elevated, ballasted, and subway tracks adjacent to moving rail vehicles and energized power rails, as well as CTA bus garages, maintenance facilities, and other Authority locations. * Subject to prevailing weather conditions when conducting field work. * Required to participate in an on\-call rotation and respond to network emergencies outside normal business hours. **EQUIPMENT, TOOLS, AND MATERIALS UTILIZED** * Standard office equipment. * Enterprise network monitoring and management tools, including LogicMonitor, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco ASDM, Cisco FMC, SolarWinds, Cisco Secure Network Analytics, HP/Juniper Mist, NetBox, Unimus, Ericsson NetCloud, Sierra Wireless, and Nokia NSP. * Enterprise networking hardware and software, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless controllers, cellular networking devices, and related diagnostic and testing equipment. * Microsoft Office Suite, Visio, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Zoom, and other business applications. jobs.title: Bioinformatics Technologist I/II
jobs.description: Join Cleveland Clinic’s Main Campus where research and surgery are advanced, technology is leading\-edge, patient care is world class and caregivers are family. In this role, you will perform software programming in various languages, including raw data quality control, sequence alignment, variant calling, annotation and reporting. You will provide input to develop software and data analysis solutions, complete department tasks and provide ongoing support for existing databases and software while working collaboratively with software engineers, computational biologists, and clinical and basic research scientists. This role will participate in translational cancer research. The laboratory of Dr. Przybyl develops novel, clinically applicable liquid biopsy testing methods for sarcoma and applies multi\-omic (genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic and methylome) high\-throughput methods to discover new diagnostic markers and therapeutic targets in sarcomas. In this role, you will build bioinformatic pipelines, analyze high\-throughput data and interpret results using statistical techniques. You will also develop and implement data analyses, acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and maintain databases. In collaboration with bioinformatics specialists, maintain and run software systems for bioinformatics processing of sequence data, including raw data quality control, sequence alignment, variant calling, annotation and reporting. Develop and implement workflows for data analysis tools in collaboration with research scientists. Build and deploy data analysis support systems for large datasets, including well\-structured flat files, APIs and other types of services. Solve problems related to data analysis and troubleshoot and adapt published methodologies. Prepare data for a variety of research projects. Assist lab members, including graduate students and postdoctoral fellows, with training on bioinformatic tools. Supervise and train trainees in their quantitative research projects. Contribute to research protocols and grant proposals. Perform other duties as assigned. jobs.title: Quality Engineer (AI Automation)
jobs.description: About Cognizant’s Quality Engineering \& Assurance Team Our Quality Engineering \& Assurance team is the innovative engine at our company. We are a dedicated group of builders and problem\-solvers responsible for the most critical, customer\-facing platforms. Within this team, the Quality practice is not a downstream function but a fully integrated partner in development. Our mission is to embed quality into every stage of the lifecycle, and as a Quality Engineer, you will be on the front lines of this effort. Position Overview Are you a driven Quality Engineer passionate about building the future of testing? We are seeking a creative and hands\-on QE to be a key contributor to our quality practice. This is an exciting opportunity to move beyond traditional QA and dive into the world of AI\-driven testing, helping us build and maintain robust quality standards for our mission\-critical intelligent applications that are redefining customer interaction. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain test automation frameworks using Java and Python. Write clean, efficient, and scalable automation scripts for new features to ensure robust test coverage across all deliverables. **Perform API testing:** Understand API concepts, develop and execute functional tests, interpret Swagger YAML files, and validate endpoints using Postman or Rest Assured automation frameworks. **Conduct database testing:** Write and execute SQL queries to retrieve, update, and delete data, ensuring database integrity and reliability. **Own quality for assigned features and components:** Collaborate with product managers and developers on requirements analysis, create detailed test cases, execute comprehensive test suites (functional, integration, regression), and provide final quality sign\-off. **Track and report testing progress:** Use tools such as JIRA, ADO, or ALM for defect logging and reporting, ensuring transparency of feature quality to the team and stakeholders. Also understanding of CI/CD concepts. **Implement and execute test plans for AI/ML applications:** Support QA activities and certify the quality of AI\-powered systems, including hands\-on testing of chatbots for intent recognition, conversational flow, response accuracy, and edge case handling. **Leverage modern AI tools to enhance workflow:** Utilize AI code assistants like GitHub Copilot to accelerate test script development and explore generative AI for tasks such as test data creation and bug report summarization. **Ensure AI reliability and fairness:** Execute test cases to identify issues related to bias, fairness, and model robustness, contributing to the overall trustworthiness of AI systems. Develop and maintain test automation scripts and frameworks using Java and Python. Have proficiency with test and defect management tools, particularly JIRA or any similar tools. Required Skills \& Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 0 – 1 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering role. Some hands\-on experience developing and maintaining test automation scripts and frameworks using Java and Python. Basic understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and practical experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. A keen interest in or prior experience testing AI\-powered applications, such as chatbots or other AI/ML\-based systems. Hands\-on experience with the Hybrid Automation frameworks. Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions). Exposure to performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling). Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker) A passion for learning and staying up to date with the latest trends in AI and software testing. Location New hires will be hired to the Cognizant office in Dallas/Plano TX, Charlotte/Cary NC, Teaneck NJ, Miami FL where you will work alongside other experienced Cognizant associates delivering technology solutions. Applicants must be willing to relocate to this major geographic area. While we attempt to honor candidate location preferences, business needs and position availability will determine final location assignment. Start Date New hires will start in September 2026 . While we will attempt to honor candidate start date preferences, business need and position availability will determine final start date assignment. Exact start date will be communicated with enough time for you to plan effectively. Salary and Other Compensation: The annual salary for this position is $65,000\.00 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. Why Choose Us? Cognizant delivers solutions that draw upon the full power and scale of our associates. You will be supported by high\-caliber experts and employ some of the most advanced and patented capabilities. Our associate’s diverse backgrounds offer multifaceted perspectives and fuel new ways of thinking. We encourage lively discussions which inspire better results for our clients. Benefits Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off 401(k) plan and contributions Long\-term/Short\-term Disability Paid Parental Leave Employee Stock Purchase Plan Disclaimer The hourly rate, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law. Work Authorization Due to the nature of this position, Cognizant cannot provide sponsorship for U.S. work authorization (including participation in a CPT/OPT program) for this role.

From carbon steel and stainless steel to aluminum and specialty alloys, we help customers keep projects moving with products built to meet demanding specifications and industry standards. We are currently seeking an Industrial Controls Engineer/Technician to join our team. This position is ideal for a motivated professional who enjoys problem\-solving and working in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. **Primary Responsibilties** * Modification, design, implementation support, and troubleshooting of both new and existing industrial automated control systems to ensure they are operating correctly, efficiently, and safely. * Selection, troubleshooting, implementation support, and repairs of various automated systems, sensors, valves, relays, motor starters, VFD’s, programmable logic controllers, actuators, HMI’s, robotic system interfaces, robotic programming and program modification, and overall system integration management. * Additional responsibilities would include assisting Plant Electricians and Millwrights with troubleshooting and implementation of various automated and mechanical systems as well as general Engineering, Manufacturing, \& Quality Group support. **Education, Experience, Skills, and Competencies** * High School diploma/GED equivalent required. * Technical Certificate or Associates Degree In Industrial Automation / Controls or equivalent. * Minimum 3 years related experience required. * Ability to create, read, and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics. * Good prioritization and communication skills (oral and writing) required. * Ability to Create, Read, And Use Ladder Code required. * Experience with Allen Bradley Logix Platforms preferred. **Work Environment** * Works in a variable single shift manufacturing environment with exposure to various electrical control panel systems, cutting operations, mechanical presses, roll forming equipment, and robotic cutting and press tending systems. * May be required to lift up to 50 pounds. * May be required to stand for long periods and walk moderate distances daily. * Routinely required to reach with hands and arms. * May be required to sit, stoop, kneel, or crouch. * Position reports to the Director of Engineering **Why Join CMF?** * Established manufacturing organization with more than 100 years of industry experience * Team\-oriented environment focused on quality, service, and reliability * Opportunity for growth and development * Competitive compensation and benefits * Meaningful role supporting customers across critical industries * Competitive salary, benefit package including health insurance, retirement plan, and paid time off. Interested candidates should submit their resume to **careers@cmforming.com** for consideration. For more information on our company, please visit www.cmforming.com *Commercial Metal Forming is an equal opportunity employer committed to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.* Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

event\-driven architectures. * Experience supporting application security initiatives and remediation of HCL AppScan findings. * Familiarity with DevSecOps practices. * Experience leading technical jobs.title: Platform Engineer II
jobs.description: Overview: This position sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment. **The Opportunity**As a Platform Engineer II, you will play a key role in building and operating the core platform that ConstructConnect’s engineering teams rely on every day. You’ll deliver secure, reliable CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and developer tooling that enable product teams to ship faster with less risk. This role balances hands\-on engineering with developer support, documentation, and platform improvement work. You’ll own complex projects end\-to\-end, contribute to larger cross\-team initiatives, and help us evolve toward an Internal Developer Platform with strong observability and self\-service capabilities. Responsibilities: **What You’ll Be Doing*** Build and improve CI/CD pipelines. Maintain and enhance GitLab CI/CD infrastructure, including shared runners, CI templates, and Terraform deployment pipelines. Troubleshoot pipeline failures and ensure autoscaling/ephemeral runners deliver fast, reliable builds and deployments. * Deliver cloud infrastructure via Terraform. Use standard Terraform modules to define and manage GCP projects, environments, and supporting services. Collaborate with Infrastructure Engineering to improve module usability and contribute documentation and examples. * Embed security and compliance into the platform. Implement policy\-as\-code checks, IAM and region guardrails, container image standards, and vulnerability scanning in CI/CD pipelines, partnering with Security. * Drive AI\-powered platform automation. Use generative and agentic AI to accelerate pipeline development, infrastructure\-as\-code authoring, documentation generation, and troubleshooting—while ensuring quality through human review and standards compliance. * Manage artifact and container image workflows. Work with Cloudsmith and related tooling to maintain artifact repositories, base images, and retention/scanning policies that support secure, efficient build and deployment pipelines. * Provide technical support and troubleshooting. Act as a tier\-2/3 technical owner for Platform Engineering support requests, resolving issues with pipelines, Terraform configurations, GitLab projects, Cloudsmith, and GCP infrastructure—and turning repeated issues into reusable patterns or documentation. * Onboard and enable product teams. Partner with teams to implement GitLab, Terraform, and GCP environments to accelerate adoption, then hand off with documentation so they can operate independently. * Contribute to platform observability. Help define and instrument metrics, logs, and dashboards for CI/CD, Terraform usage, and platform health to support continuous improvement and roadmap initiatives. * Maintain and improve documentation. Keep the Developer Hub, runbooks, examples, and how\-to guides accurate and discoverable so teams can self\-serve and understand platform capabilities. * This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications: **What You Bring to the Team**### **Required** * 6\+ years of professional experience in infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering roles * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling, with strong preference for GitLab CI (pipelines, shared runners, multi\-stage workflows, templates) * Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform as a consumer of shared modules, including: * Reading and understanding module inputs/outputs * Interpreting Terraform plans/diffs and state * Wiring standard modules into team or environment\-specific configurations safely * Practical experience with artifact management, ideally Cloudsmith or similar systems for build artifacts, container images, and Terraform modules * Solid understanding of GCP fundamentals—projects, IAM, service accounts, networking basics (VPC, subnets, load balancing), and common platform services (e.g., Cloud Run, CloudSQL) * Experience building and operating containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes or similar orchestration technologies * Proficiency in scripting/automation (Bash / Python) for CI job automation, Terraform tooling, and reporting * Demonstrated ability to debug complex issues across CI pipelines, Terraform plans/state, IAM, and GCP resources, working from logs, error messages, and metrics * Experience with security and compliance controls in cloud or platform contexts (e.g., IAM least\-privilege, vulnerability scanning, policy\-as\-code, audit/report needs) * Strong communication skills; able to document decisions clearly, collaborate across Engineering, Architecture, Security, Finance, Infrastructure Engineering, Networking, and Service Delivery teams, and provide calm, clear guidance through support channels * A service\- and product\-minded approach: you care about developer experience, adoption of standards, and making the paved road the easiest road ### **Preferred / Nice to Have** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Google Cloud or equivalent cloud certifications * Experience contributing to or operating internal developer platforms, service catalogs, or developer portals * Experience with observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards) and defining or working to SLOs for platform components * Experience using generative AI tools to assist with code, documentation, and troubleshooting **Physical Demands and Work Environment*** The physical activities of this position include frequent sitting, telephone communication, and working on a computer for extended periods. Visual acuity is required to perform activities close to the eyes. * Team members are expected to maintain a dedicated and ergonomically appropriate remote workspace. * Team members who live within commuting distance of our office location (Atlanta, Georgia) are expected to work in a hybrid capacity, with regular in\-office presence every Tuesday and Wednesday each week. * All team members must reside and perform their work within the United States. **E\-Verify Statement** ConstructConnect utilizes the E\-Verify program with every potential new hire. This makes it possible for us to make certain that every employee who works for ConstructConnect is eligible to work in the United States. To learn more about E\-Verify you can call 1\-800\-255\-7688 or visit their website. E\-Verify® is a registered trademark of the United States Department of Homeland Security. Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Civil Engineering Associate
jobs.description: **CAREER DESCRIPTION** ---------------------- **CIVIL ENGINEERING ASSOCIATE** *Salary may be negotiable within the range listed above, based on position requirements and successful candidate's qualifications, subject to appropriate authorization.* **OPEN TO THE PUBLIC** This recruitment will establish an open eligible list that will be used to fill current and future **Civil Engineering Associate**positions. The eligible list established may also be used to fill positions in similar and/or lower classifications throughout the County of Orange. **DEADLINE TO APPLY** This recruitment will be open for a minimum of five (5\) business days and will close on **Thursday****, September 17, 2026, at 11:59 P.M. (PT**). **OC INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAMS/OC DEVELOPMENT SERVICES/OC PUBLIC WORKS** OC Infrastructure Programs provides engineering services for roadways in unincorporated areas and regional flood control programs throughout Orange County. This includes programming, design, legislation tracking, project management, traffic safety, and development coordination services. OC Development Services oversees the planning and development entitlement requirements for private and public projects within the County’s unincorporated areas. This includes permit processing, inspection services and management of zoning, building and code regulations – all to ensure safe and responsible property development and community standards. OC Public Works provides services on a regional basis to unincorporated areas, to cities, and to other County agencies and departments. The primary mission of the department is to protect and enrich the community through efficient delivery and maintenance of public works infrastructure, planning, and development services. OC Public Works' core values are integrity, accountability, service and trust. OCPW is a unique County department comprised of ten (10\) service areas: Administrative Services, Agricultural Commissioner/Sealer of Weights \& Measures; OC Construction; OC Development Services; OC Environmental Resources; OC Facilities Design \& Construction and CUF; OC Facilities Maintenance \& OC Fleet Services; OC Infrastructure Programs; OC Operations \& Maintenance. **THE OPPORTUNITY** OC Public Works is seeking an experienced, non\-registered civil engineering professional to perform a variety of field and office civil engineering work as a Civil Engineering Associate. Positions at this level are responsible for journey\-level assignments and perform independent engineering analysis and recommendations while generally working under the project leadership of Civil Engineers. Assignments may involve complex or specialized engineering projects across roadway, active transportation, flood control, hydrology, hydraulics, and infrastructure project development. OC Infrastructure Programs is currently recruiting for four (4\) Civil Engineering Associate positions. Assignments include two positions within the Project Development Unit, one position withing the Hydrology Unit, and one position within the Flood Design Unit. OC Development Services is currently recruiting for one (1\) Civil Engineering Associate position. Assignment will be withing the Building and Safety Unit. Responsibilities and duties for this position include, but are not limited to, the following:* Developing and evaluating infrastructure projects * Performing and coordinating civil engineering analyses and studies * Developing project programming and delivery documents * Preparing, reviewing, and coordinating engineering plans, specifications, reports, studies, calculations, and other technical documents * Managing and coordinating projects and consultants * Conducting field investigations and site evaluations * Reviewing plans and engineering calculations for residential and nonresidential construction projects **DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS** **AND CORE COMPETENCIES** Recent experience with using computer modeling software for urban planning and/or CADD (Computer Aided Drafting \& Design) systems is highly desirable, but not required. jobs.title: Lead Product Designer - Design Foundations, Interstate
jobs.description: **About the Team** The Design Foundations team is a small group of designers and engineers focused on improving the quality and efficiency of product design at Cox Automotive. We build the tools, practices, and processes used by all designers and front\-end engineers across the organization. Our most established work includes two design systems: Interstate (for B2B products) and Iris (for consumer\-facing products). More recently, we've been building AI tools like MCP connectors, context, and skills that deliver on our mission of quality and efficiency. **About the Role** We are looking for a **Lead Product Designer** to own the design of Interstate, our B2B design system and the shared foundation beneath every Cox Automotive B2B product. You will be the senior\-most individual contributor and design voice for Interstate, reporting to the Design Director, and the person other designers look to for where the system should go next. This isn't a role where you maintain a component library in isolation. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and the broader organization to create tools, components, and infrastructure that make everyone around you faster and better. As AI\-assisted design and development accelerates, the design system becomes the source of truth that ensures quality and consistency at scale, whether a component was composed by a person or an agent. The playbook for "design systems \+ AI" is being written right now, and you want to help write it. **What You'll Do** * Own and evolve Interstate: guidelines, tokens, components, reusable patterns, and the structural decisions that keep the system coherent as it grows across teams and products. * Set design direction for new, ambiguous features where none exists yet, and tie that direction to product and customer value. * Set the quality bar for design execution, accessibility, and usability that every other team inherits. * Create interaction and visual patterns that work across product areas and user types, and know when to push beyond the system to solve a novel problem while maintaining consistency. * Define the rules of the road for Interstate: contribution, versioning, and deprecation models that let the system evolve quickly without fragmenting, so teams know how to propose, adopt, and retire patterns. * Shape the design side of Interstate's AI tooling: make the system machine\-readable, define how agents compose UIs from its components correctly, and direct the output of design and prototyping tools. * Spot the opportunity no one assigned you. Talk to product managers, designers, and engineers, find where the system falls short, take the initiative to fix it, communicate the change across the org, and measure whether it landed. * Grow the design judgment of other designers through critique, pairing, and clear standards, so good decisions hold up when you are not in the room. **Who You Are** * Bachelor's degree in a related discipline and 6 years' experience in a related field; or a different combination, such as a master's degree and 4 years' experience; a Ph.D. and 1 years' experience in a related field; or 10 years' experience in a related field. * **A systems thinker.** You understand the layer beneath the screens: token architecture, components and their states, patterns other people adopted, a contribution or governance model. You can explain why a pattern exists, when to break it, and how one decision cascades across products. * **Obsessed with craft and quality in visuals and interactions.** You sweat the border radius, the focus ring, the token name, the state nobody thought to design. You believe a design system's job is to raise the floor for quality everywhere. * **High agency and high influence.** You do not wait for a ticket, and you are energized by problems that don't have established solutions yet. You get involved upstream, where product direction is still forming, and shape it before decisions harden, moving designers, engineers, and senior stakeholders alike through clarity rather than authority. "Lead" is the operative word. * **Biased toward shipping.** You know when to polish and when to ship. You use every tool at your disposal to move fast without sacrificing the quality your teammates depend on. * **A clear communicator and teacher.** Systems work is advocacy, documentation, and helping others succeed. You can make the case to designers and engineers alike, and you can teach the reasoning behind your taste so it outlives any single decision. * **Fluent with AI\-assisted design.** You already work with AI tooling and agent\-based workflows, and you have a point of view on what a design system owes them: what agents need from components, tokens, and documentation to compose UIs correctly. * **Accessible by default.** You have a strong grasp of WCAG and hands\-on experience designing and testing for assistive technologies. * **Outcome driven.** You connect design decisions to outcomes and can show whether a change moved something. **Nice to Haves** * Leading or contributing to a widely adopted or open\-source design system, including the ongoing stewardship: change management, support, office hours, and reviews. * Depth with Figma variables, theming, and token pipelines such as Style Dictionary, and how design connects to code. * Have created AI tooling for design: agents, MCP, context, and prompt\-based workflows. * Experience implementing design decisions in code (React, web components, HTML/CSS) or enough technical know\-how to collaborate deeply with engineers. USD 111,500\.00 \- 185,900\.00 per year **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $111,500\.00 \- $185,900\.00\. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. **Benefits:** The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave. EOE, including disability/vets

Crafton Tull is a 100% employee\-owned planning, design, and surveying firm dedicated to improving communities. As an employee\-owner, you'll have a direct, long\-term stake in Crafton Tull's continued success. This sense of ownership drives everything we do. cost, determines feasibility of project based on analysis of collected data, and prepares detailed cost estimates. * Uses computer assisted engineering and design software to perform calculations and
