experience building robust, maintainable backend services and automation Extensive hands\-on experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure); multi\-cloud experience is a strong jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Department: Engineering** **Reports To: Senior Electrical Design Engineer** **Employment Type: Full\-Time** **Location: Summerville, SC** **Industry: Marine / Boat Manufacturing** **Position Summary** We are seeking an Entry\-Level Electrical Design Engineer to join our engineering team and support the design, documentation, testing, and production of electrical systems for boats. Working under the direction of the Senior Electrical Design Engineer, this position will provide an opportunity to develop practical experience in marine electrical system design, wiring harness development, electrical documentation, component selection, and production support. The ideal candidate is an organized, detail\-oriented engineer who enjoys solving problems, learning how products are built, and working closely with both engineering and manufacturing teams. The successful candidate will develop their technical skills while contributing to the design and improvement of production boats. **Key Responsibilities** **Electrical Design \& Engineering Support** * Assist the Senior Electrical Design Engineer with the development of electrical systems for new and existing boat models. * Create and update electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, and related documentation under engineering direction. * Assist with electrical system layouts, wire routing, component locations, and electrical architecture. * Perform basic electrical calculations, including wire sizing, voltage drop, circuit loading, and circuit protection. * Assist with the selection and specification of electrical components. * Develop and maintain electrical bills of materials, wire lists, component lists, and other engineering documentation. * Assist with engineering changes and updates to existing boat models. * Assist in design of different enclosures for electrical components. * Participate in design reviews and engineering meetings. * Maintain accurate revision control of electrical drawings and documentation. **Standards \& Compliance** * Learn and apply applicable marine electrical standards and company engineering requirements. * Develop familiarity with ABYC, USCG, NMMA, and other applicable standards. * Assist in reviewing designs for compliance under the direction of the Senior Electrical Design Engineer. * Maintain awareness of electrical safety requirements and company design practices. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related field. Industry experience can be considered in place of degree. * 0–2 years of professional engineering experience; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. * Basic understanding of electrical circuits and DC electrical systems. * Ability to read and understand electrical schematics. * Basic understanding of wire sizing, voltage drop, circuit protection, and electrical loads. * Familiarity with CAD software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, SolidWorks Electrical, EPLAN, or similar. * Strong computer skills and willingness to learn engineering software and company systems. * Strong attention to detail. * Good organizational and documentation skills. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, production personnel, and other departments. * Willingness to learn and work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * The following are helpful but not required: * Internship or co\-op experience in electrical engineering or manufacturing. * Exposure to marine, automotive, recreational vehicle, aerospace, powersports, or other vehicle electrical systems. * Familiarity with electrical connectors, terminals, wire harnesses, and circuit protection. * Basic knowledge of NMEA 2000 marine network. * Experience using a multimeter or other electrical test equipment. * Hands\-on experience building or troubleshooting electrical systems. * Personal or academic projects involving electrical systems, controls, robotics, vehicles, boats, or similar products. **Relationship with Senior Electrical Design Engineer** * The Senior Electrical Design Engineer will provide technical direction, mentoring, design review, and approval for the Electrical Design Engineer I. * The Electrical Design Engineer I will be expected to: * Seek guidance when encountering unfamiliar or complex electrical design issues. * Prepare preliminary designs and documentation for review. * Incorporate feedback from design reviews. * Learn and follow established company electrical design standards. * Gradually assume responsibility for increasingly complex engineering tasks. * Develop the knowledge and judgment necessary to eventually manage electrical design projects with greater independence. * This structure provides the opportunity for the engineer to gain hands\-on experience while maintaining appropriate technical oversight for production boat electrical systems.

engineering teams in the U.S. and India. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Perform power system engineering studies and data analysis related to bulk transmission, distributed generation, and power quality. * Conduct transmission and distribution planning studies. * Support renewable energy grid integration studies involving solar, wind, battery storage, and other generation resources. * Perform power system reliability assessments and related engineering analyses. * Support engineering studies involving utility power systems and renewable generation facilities. * Develop, maintain, and analyze power system models using industry\-standard simulation software. * Utilize tools such as PSCAD/EMTDC, PSS/E, Simulink for Power Systems, TARA, or similar platforms. * Prepare clear, concise engineering reports documenting methodologies, study results, findings, and recommendations. * Analyze engineering and power system data using Python, Excel, R, or other programming and data analysis tools. * Support generator and large\-load interconnection studies and related technical analyses. * Apply knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and applicable FERC Orders. * Support projects involving North American ISO/RTO and utility transmission planning and interconnection procedures. * Work with systems and markets including MISO, PJM, ERCOT, SPP, ISO\-NE, NYISO, CAISO, AESO, IESO, and others. * Manage or support multiple engineering projects and client engagements simultaneously. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, vendors, utilities, developers, and other stakeholders. * Identify technical and project\-related problems and recommend practical solutions. * Participate in client meetings, ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings, industry conferences, and technical discussions as needed. * Maintain project schedules, deliverables, and deadlines in a fast\-paced consulting environment. * Take ownership of assigned engineering work and Power Systems Engineer position. * Experience supporting North American energy market analysis and/or working within the U.S. or Canadian power sector. * Strong background in electric power systems analysis and modeling. * Hands\-on expertise with at least one major power system simulation package such as PSCAD/EMTDC, PSS/E, Simulink for Power Systems, TARA, or equivalent. * Experience with transmission planning, distribution planning, renewable grid integration, power system economics, reliability assessment, or related studies. * Programming and/or data analysis experience using Python, R, Excel, or another major programming language or analytical tool. * Knowledge of North American electric power transmission and generation systems. * Experience working with multidisciplinary project teams. * Ability to manage multiple projects, assignments, and deadlines simultaneously. * Strong technical report writing and presentation skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and take ownership of deliverables. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Candidates requiring current or future visa sponsorship may be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electric Power Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline from an accredited U.S. or Canadian university. * Professional Engineer (PE) license in a U.S. state, P.Eng. registration in a Canadian province, or the ability to obtain professional licensure. * Experience with renewable energy generation, including solar, wind, and battery energy storage systems. * Experience performing advanced transmission and distribution system studies. * Working knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards. * Knowledge of FERC Orders governing generator and large\-load interconnection. * Familiarity with ISO/RTO and utility interconnection and transmission planning procedures. * Experience working with MISO, PJM, ERCOT, SPP, ISO\-NE, NYISO, CAISO, AESO, IESO, or other North American system operators. * Project management experience within power systems engineering or energy consulting. * Experience working directly with utilities, developers, ISOs/RTOs, government agencies, or other electric power industry clients. * Experience mentoring, training, or leading junior engineering professionals. * Ability to help develop and lead multidisciplinary engineering teams. **Work Environment / Schedule** * Full\-time position. * Candidates may be located within the United States or Canada. * Continuum Associates is headquartered in Columbia, Maryland. * Hybrid and remote work arrangements may be considered for well\-qualified candidates. * Position requires collaboration with engineering teams, clients, utilities, vendors, and other stakeholders across multiple locations. * Ability to manage multiple projects and strict deadlines within a fast\-paced consulting environment is required. * Business travel is expected to be less than 20% of the time. * Travel may include client sites, ISO/RTO stakeholder meetings, industry conferences, and Continuum offices. * Some international travel may be required. * Candidates must have a valid driver's license and passport and be able to travel across the U.S.\-Canada border as required. **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive base salary commensurate with experience and location. * Performance\-based bonus. * Medical insurance. * Dental insurance. * Vision insurance. * Retirement plan participation. * Paid time off. * Opportunities to work on advanced power system and renewable energy projects. * Exposure to major utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, investors, government agencies, and other power industry stakeholders. * Opportunities for professional development, technical leadership, and team growth. **EEO Statement** * status, or any other legally protected characteristic under applicable U.S. or Canadian law.

jobs.description: We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! Foundational Services provides horizontal capabilities—including identity, licensing, data, AI, and developer experience—that are consumed by software businesses across Siemens. least\-privilege, blast\-radius\-contained authority for coding assistants and autonomous agents, verifiable machine identity, and validation of AI\-generated code * Partner across Siemens cybersecurity, IT, legal, privacy, product\-security, and business\-unit organizations through clear interfaces and shared operating models, harmonizing security practices while addressing legitimate product, regulatory, and deployment differences. * Build a community of security architects, engineers, and champions across Foundational Services, OSES, and the Siemens businesses. * Build, lead, and grow the security engineering team for OSES and Foundational Services \- recruiting, developing, and retaining the talent that owns security across the developer enablement platform every Siemens team builds on. * Establish measurable security and developer\-experience outcomes, including risk reduction, control automation and continuous control validation, vulnerability remediation, platform adoption, and security that scales through platform and automation leverage; a deliberate bias toward compounding efficiency as OSES scales. **Why us?** Working at Siemens Software means flexibility \- Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! **Siemens Software.** ***Transform the Everyday*** \#LI\-PLM \#LI\-HYBRID \#SWSaaS 212,900 383,300 25\-35

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Job title \- Principal Full Stack Engineer** Employment type \- Full\-time employee (FTE) Work location \- 100% remote Travel \- Minimal \- occasional team and conference travel Base salary band $125,000 \- $185,000 (Band B5\) Target start date Before the end of October 2026 **About Slater Certified®** Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. It delivers self\-paced training that prepares professionals for licensure and continuing education, built around G.A.I.L. (Generative Artificial Intelligence Learning) \- an interactive tutor that gives real\-time feedback, personalized explanations and adaptive support, so someone studying on demand still gets guidance. The flagship course is a 40\-hour Wastewater Class 3 Operator Training recognized by the Georgia Secretary of State, alongside a 24\-hour continuing education course and an industrial wastewater program. Organizations can run a customized version, Powered by Slater Certified®, against their own workforce. Slater Certified, LLC is the workforce development arm of Slater Infrastructure Group, LLC \- an Alpharetta, Georgia infrastructure services firm founded in 1997, working across operations and maintenance, construction engineering and inspection, and environmental services for public and private clients. Slater Certified launched in July 2025 and is licensed in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia and Mississippi. The team is small and moves fast. Technology choices are modern and made by the people who have to live with them, so the distance between an idea and a decision is short, and the distance between a decision and shipping it is shorter. Work is remote and the schedule is flexible. Ownership sits with the person doing the work, and there is real room to shape how things get built rather than inheriting someone else's process. **Position summary** Slater Certified® runs a React front end and an Express back end on Vercel, with Firestore behind it and G.A.I.L., our generative AI tutor, at the center of the learning experience. The platform is live, it carries real learners against state\-approved curricula, and it is about to be asked to do considerably more than it was originally built for. This is a 100% hands\-on coding position. The person in this seat writes production code every day and builds the hardest parts of the platform personally. Architectural direction is set by the Chief Technology \& Business Officer; you are the senior engineering voice feeding into those decisions and the person who turns them into working software. It is a small team, so what you build reaches learners quickly and there is nowhere to hide. **What this role owns in the first 12 months** * Is shipping production code across the front end, API and data layer inside the first month, and keeps doing it for the life of the role. * Is the CTBO's working partner on architecture \- bringing options, trade\-offs and a recommendation rather than waiting to be told. * Sets the engineering standards that stick: testing, code review, what “done” means, and the release path from TEST to production. * Removes the top three scaling or reliability risks in the platform \- identified inside the first 60 days, closed by month twelve. * Raises the technical level of the team around them, measurably, in code review and in what others are able to ship unaided. * Is the person the CTBO can hand a hard technical problem to and not follow up on. **Key responsibilities** Hands\-on engineering \- 100% of this role * Write production code every day. This is not a role that stops coding, and it is not a step toward management. * Build the hardest parts of the platform personally. * Design and build the APIs and services the rest of the platform depends on. * Work across React, Express, Firestore and the Vercel deployment path. **Architecture and technical input** * Architectural direction is set by the CTBO. You are the senior engineering voice in those decisions. * Bring options, trade\-offs and a recommendation \- not just an implementation once the decision has been made. * Document how the platform actually fits together, and keep that picture current. * Weigh what ships this quarter against what the platform will need in two years. AI and the product * Build and extend the platform on top of G.A.I.L., our generative AI tutor. * Advise on where generative AI genuinely improves the learning product and where it does not. Engineering excellence * Set and hold coding standards, review practice and the definition of done. * Mentor engineers directly, in code review and in design. * Improve the release path so that deploying is routine rather than an event. * Support hiring \- interview, calibrate, and help build the team. Security, compliance and reliability * Build authentication and authorization correctly. * Build to FERPA expectations for learner data and to the standards our state approvals depend on. * Instrument the platform so failures surface before a learner reports them. **Must have** * 10\+ years building production software, several of them at principal, staff or equivalent technical\-lead level. * Has been accountable for the architecture of a production system, and lived with the consequences of those decisions. * Deep JavaScript and TypeScript, with real depth in React on the front end and Node / Express on the back end. * Production experience with a cloud\-hosted document database \- Firestore, MongoDB, DynamoDB or similar. * Has raised the technical level of a team through review, mentoring and standards, without formal authority to do it. * Has shipped production features built on generative AI APIs, with hands\-on experience using Claude. * Has been the most senior engineer in the room, and been right often enough that people stopped checking. * Wants a hands\-on coding role. This is not a route into engineering management. **Nice to have** * Experience with other generative AI APIs alongside Claude \- Gemini, OpenAI or similar. * Vercel, serverless or edge deployment experience. * EdTech, LMS, credentialing or regulated\-training background. * Infrastructure as code, and ownership of a CI/CD pipeline. * Accessibility standards (WCAG) applied in practice rather than in theory. **Compensation and benefits** Base salary band $125,000 \- $185,000, based on experience Variable compensation \- Eligible for participation in annual company bonus pool Health, dental, vision \- Employer provided / supplemented Retirement \- 401(k) \- up to 5% matched Paid time off \- Earned over time: generous and flexible policy **Work environment** **100% remote** Slater Certified® is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Advisory Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: At SolarWinds, we're a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions. The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We're looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you're looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you've come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us! **ROLE OVERVIEW** As an Advisory Analytics Engineer, you will own end\-to\-end analytics delivery — from well\-governed dbt data models through to polished Tableau dashboards or AI solutions consumed by business leaders across Marketing, Revenue, Customer Success, and Product. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role with balanced accountability across transformation and delivery. You'll spend roughly half your time on dbt model development and half on Tableau dashboard delivery and business stakeholder engagement — the bridge between our Analytics Engineering platform and the business teams who rely on it. You'll collaborate closely with our AE community in Austin, Ireland and the Philippines, aligning data models and metrics to real business requirements. You will also be a point person in our San Francisco privet equity office building data solutions alongside their analytics engineering team. The right candidate is equally comfortable writing production\-grade dbt SQL and sitting with a senior stakeholder to translate a business question into a data product. You bring craft to both sides of that equation. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, build, and maintain dbt data models (Mart, Conformed, Rpt layers) following SolarWinds modelling standards, with a Finance, and Product — from requirements through to stakeholder sign\-off * Own the Tableau\-to\-dbt integration layer: consume MetricFlow semantic layer definitions in Tableau Cloud, ensuring metrics are consistent, governed, and aligned with company\-wide standards * Partner directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into model specifications and analytics deliverables — the primary analytics contact for your assigned business domains * Champion data quality — write dbt tests, enforce delivery SLAs, and embed lineage documentation as standard practice * Lead and run CI/CD processes for your dbt models — branch\-based development, PR reviews, and automated test gates * Support and mentor junior and mid\-level analysts, promoting best practices in SQL, dbt modelling, and Tableau development * Contribute to the rollout of self\-serve analytics enablement programmes for business users, reducing dependency on direct analyst requests * This role requires periodic onsite visits to our privet equity sponsors office in San Fransico **REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE** * 5\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a related data role * skills — you build governed, performant, and user\-friendly dashboards from scratch and can explain design decisions to stakeholders * Python proficiency for analytics use cases — data wrangling, scripting, custom dbt macros, or exploratory analysis * Strong SQL fundamentals — complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs, aggregations, and query performance awareness * Experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift) including understanding of materialisation and performance trade\-offs * Git and branch\-based development workflows — you treat analytics code with software engineering discipline * CI/CD experience in a data context — dbt test gates, PR\-triggered runs, or equivalent pipeline automation * Solid understanding of data modelling production environment * Hands on experience with demand / marketing funnel data (web, download, trial, lead) * Familiarity with Salesforce or NetSuite as source systems * Experience in a SaaS or recurring revenue business — ARR, churn, expansion, and NRR metrics * Exposure to Dataplex, Fivetran, or similar data cataloguing and ELT tooling * Experience with next\-generation self\-serve BI jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Developer
jobs.description: **Build Software That Matters—From a 400\-Acre Horse Ranch** **Senior Full\-Stack Software Developer \| AI\-First** **Gainesville, Texas** Full\-Time **Hybrid** Premium Housing Available Tired of corporate red tape, endless meetings, and jumping through hoops to get a good idea into production? Picture spending your on\-site workdays at a beautiful, 400\-acre ranch, working directly with an involved founder in the equine business. You can talk through an idea, see the operation it supports, and build something that makes someone’s day easier. If you’re looking for a change of pace and environment—with meaningful technical challenges and room to take ownership—this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for. We’re hiring an experienced, AI\-first software developer to maintain and improve multiple applications supporting our equine, agricultural, and veterinary businesses, including our Spade AI assistant. **THE OPPORTUNITY** You’ll work directly with the founder as our primary developer, with a clear connection between what you build and the people who use it. We need someone who enjoys solving problems, moves quickly, and can take an idea from conversation through launch. You should be comfortable maintaining existing applications, improving what’s already working, and making sound technical decisions independently. Personality matters here. You must be friendly, approachable, collaborative, and ready to tackle new challenges. You’ll work with people who know their businesses deeply and need a developer who listens, asks thoughtful questions, and enjoys finding solutions together. Learning the equine and veterinary world can feel like learning a new language. There are specialized terms, complex workflows, and important details behind everyday decisions. You don’t need to arrive knowing everything, but you do need the curiosity, patience, and willingness to learn. **WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON** * Maintain and improve multiple business applications. * Build features supporting ranch, equine, and veterinary operations. * Develop and improve Spade AI and other AI\-powered features. * Connect applications with payment, accounting, and other business systems. * Troubleshoot issues across interfaces, backend services, databases, and integrations. * Own implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. * Work with the founder to prioritize improvements with the greatest practical impact. * Keep systems secure, reliable, and documented. **AI SKILLS WE NEED** AI should already be central to how you work. You should use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or similar platforms to accelerate development—and have the experience to review, test, and stand behind the results. You must also understand how to build and improve AI features inside an application. We’re looking for experience with: * Integrating large language models through APIs. * Designing effective prompts, instructions, and structured outputs. * Connecting AI to relevant business records, terminology, and knowledge. * Building feedback and memory systems that improve future responses. * Creating realistic evaluation examples and measuring accuracy. * Understanding model training and fine\-tuning, including when they are appropriate. * Protecting sensitive information and keeping human review in workflows where mistakes have meaningful consequences. You’ll help Spade better understand our terminology, workflows, and user preferences, and turn that understanding into useful, dependable assistance. **OUR TECHNOLOGY STACKS** * Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. * Solo Equine backend: Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma, with Redis and BullMQ. * Veterinary application: Next.js with Supabase/PostgreSQL and NextAuth. * Mobile: React Native and Expo. * Development and quality: GitHub, automated deployment workflows, Playwright, Vitest, Jest, and Sentry. You should have strong full\-stack experience and be comfortable learning your way around existing codebases. **INTEGRATION EXPERIENCE IS ESSENTIAL** A strong working understanding of Stripe and QuickBooks Online integrations is required, ideally with experience building and maintaining them in production. * Stripe: Card and ACH payments, refunds, webhooks, and accurate payment\-status handling. * QuickBooks Online: OAuth connections, customer and invoice mapping, payments, credits, and accounting synchronization. * Reliable integrations: API limits, secure credentials, retries, duplicate prevention, error recovery, and resolving discrepancies between systems. We value speed and sound judgment. These systems handle real money and business records, so accuracy matters. **WHO WILL THRIVE HERE** * You’ve independently shipped and maintained production software. * You’re comfortable being the primary developer alongside a hands\-on founder. * You’re friendly, dependable, and willing to work through unfamiliar challenges. * You have some familiarity with agriculture, ranching, livestock, or the equine industry. * You’re enthusiastic about learning the language and details of equine and veterinary operations. * You can turn a business conversation into a practical technical solution. * You communicate clearly, follow through, and take ownership. * You enjoy seeing firsthand how people use what you build. **LOCATION, SCHEDULE \& WHAT WE OFFER** * A beautiful workplace: On\-site work at a 400\-acre ranch in Gainesville, Texas. * Hybrid flexibility: Full\-time position with at least three days per week on\-site and remote work available on the remaining days. * Direct founder access: Work closely with the person making business decisions. * Meaningful ownership: Help shape applications that people rely on every day. * Compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability. * Benefits: 401(k), health insurance, paid vacation, and paid sick days. * Premium housing available for qualified candidates: A one\-bedroom/one\-bathroom or two\-bedroom/two\-bathroom apartment. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship. **INTERESTED? SHOW US WHAT YOU’VE BUILT.** Send your résumé or LinkedIn profile and a brief introduction covering: * Software you’ve built and maintained, and what you personally owned. * How you use AI in your development workflow. * AI features or assistants you’ve built and how you evaluated their performance. * Your experience with Stripe and QuickBooks Online. * Your connection to agriculture or the equine industry. * Your availability to work in Gainesville and whether you’re interested in housing. Bring your technical skills, a friendly attitude, and a willingness to learn. Help us build the software behind a business you can experience firsthand. Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Paid sick time * Paid time off * Work from home Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gainesville, TX 76240

jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description: **About the role** We are hiring our first dedicated AI developer. The purpose of this role is not to run experiments or produce proposals, but to design, build, and maintain working systems that our teams rely on every day. The scope is intentionally broad. Wherever a manual process, bottleneck, or repetitive decision could be handled faster and more consistently through automation or applied AI, that falls within your remit. Some of these opportunities will be apparent immediately. Many of them you will identify yourself. This position is well suited to a developer earlier in their career who is capable of more than their résumé currently reflects. You will not be maintaining an existing codebase or working through a ticket queue. You will be given substantive problems, direct access to the people affected by them, and considerable latitude in determining how to solve them. **Responsibilities** Your core responsibility is to identify where AI and automation create meaningful leverage within the business, build those systems, deploy them to real users, and keep them running reliably. Initial priorities will center on our CRM and case management systems: automating intake and data entry, generating case summaries and first\-draft correspondence, enabling natural\-language search across our records, and improving the integrations between systems that were not designed to work together. These represent the clearest near\-term opportunities we have identified. They are not the limit of the role. Depending on business needs and your particular strengths, the work may extend to: * Document and data pipelines, including extraction, classification, and validation at volume * Internal tools that make AI capabilities directly accessible to non\-technical staff * Reporting and analysis functions that currently require significant manual effort * Client\-facing automation, where accuracy standards and failure modes carry greater consequence * Evaluation and monitoring infrastructure to detect degradation in model output * Build\-versus\-buy assessments and vendor evaluation We will not be providing a fixed multi\-year roadmap. We would prefer that you help build one. **Qualifications** We weigh demonstrated ability more heavily than credentials. A computer science degree is not required, and we welcome applications from bootcamp graduates, self\-taught developers, and career changers. **Required** * Strong proficiency in Python or a comparable language, with the ability to write, debug, and structure production code * Working knowledge of APIs and system integration * Competence with SQL and relational data * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic, including prompt design and handling non\-deterministic output * Sound judgment regarding when AI is the appropriate solution and when a simpler approach would serve better **Preferred** * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, or embeddings * Familiarity with a major CRM platform (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Dynamics) or case management software * Front\-end development skills sufficient to build internal tools * Experience with cloud deployment, containerization, or CI/CD * Exposure to handling regulated or confidential data **Attributes that matter as much as technical skill** * The ability to take an imprecisely defined problem from a non\-technical colleague, ask the right clarifying questions, and deliver a working solution * A bias toward deploying and iterating rather than extended pre\-launch refinement * Rigor in testing your own work before it reaches users * The willingness to say when an approach is flawed, including when the approach is ours You should also be comfortable operating as the only person in the organization performing this function. You will encounter unfamiliar problems without a senior engineer to escalate to. Some developers find this environment energizing; others do not. We would encourage you to assess honestly which applies to you before applying. **What we offer** * **Genuine ownership.** You will lead this function. The systems built here will be yours. * **Direct access.** No intermediate layers between you and the people whose work you are improving, or the decision\-maker who approves your proposals. * **A demonstrable portfolio.** Production systems you designed end to end, with measurable results attached — a meaningful asset for the remainder of your career. We recognize that this compensation range sits below what an experienced AI engineer commands. The role is structured accordingly: we are offering scope, autonomy, and accelerated growth to a developer at the stage of their career where that exchange is worthwhile, with the expectation that compensation will follow demonstrated results. **This role may not be a good fit if** * You require detailed specifications before beginning work * You prefer extended research over delivering a functional first version * You wish to work exclusively on model development without involvement in integration, data quality, or user support These are not deficiencies, but they are poorly matched to this position, and identifying that early serves both parties. Pay: $19\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer, Atlanta
jobs.description: ### **Atlanta** **Field Service Engineer** **Location: Atlanta** We are seeking a high\-performing, customer\-focused Service Professional to drive customer satisfaction and service growth for the VERITON® SPECT/CT and D\-SPECT product lines. This role is responsible for executing service strategies, building strong customer relationships, and achieving or exceeding assigned service KPI targets. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in biomedical engineering, field repairs, and customer support. Spectrum Dynamics Medical develops, manufactures, sells, and services state\-of\-the\-art nuclear medicine imaging systems. We are transforming the Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography (SPECT) imaging systems market from analog to digital detection technology, enabling hospitals and clinicians to provide superior healthcare services at significantly lower costs. We launched the world’s first *digital* cardiac dedicated SPECT system, the D\-SPECT Cardio system, in 2007\. Since then, the D\-SPECT® has become the system of choice for functional cardiac imaging, with hundreds of systems sold worldwide. We then launched the VERITON® SPECT/CT, which employs identical digital detectors made of Cadmium Zinc Telluride (“CZT”). Along with ingenious hardware design, proprietary software, and proprietary algorithms, this enables imaging at unprecedented speed, with a low radiation dose, and superior image quality. The VERITON® SPECT/CT is a platform for next\-generation imaging and therapy\-guiding applications. **Position Responsibilities** The Field Service Engineer (FSE) will create/execute resources and programs to continuously improve the satisfaction and loyalty of Spectrum Dynamics’ existing and future customers, and provide excellent field service support for DSPECT® and VERITON\-CT®. The FSE will also have direct input to the Director of Service, Operations, and the engineering teams. This input is critical to further enhance product reliability, operability, and serviceability on a global basis. Among other things, the FSE’s role will require him/her to: * Provide onsite and remote support for break\-fix issues related to software, hardware, and IT, and their clinical applications. * Execute new system installations, field upgrades, and preventive maintenance for the company’s range of products. * Take personal ownership of the customer experience. Facilitate customer satisfaction through identification of any concerns and initiation of problem resolution and escalation. * Identify and make any necessary independent decisions on who to engage to obtain requisite resources for problem resolution in a timely fashion. * Directly communicate and build rapport with customers as required. Follow up directly with customers to ensure that all issues are resolved. * Support new product introductions and first of kind installations. * Provide status reporting to internal/external customer support teams. * Participate as a technical resource and/or customer advocate as needed. * Work collaboratively with the assigned sales and application professionals in addressing and resolving customer satisfaction issues, and/or implementing sales and service solutions to meet customer needs to drive revenue for the company. * Improve productivity by highlighting deficiencies and recommending changes in tools, training, and processes. * Report to the Director of Service. **Experiences, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * S. in Biomedical Engineering or Electrical Engineering (or equivalent education) preferred. * Experience servicing and troubleshooting Industrial equipment. * 3 years of experience servicing/installing medical imaging equipment (CT or PET, while Nuclear equipment is preferred). * Significant skills and qualifications with handling computers, software installations and upgrades, and electronic\-mechanic assembly. * Ability to work independently. * Willingness to travel in order to support other locations in the US and abroad. * Strong sense of customer service with excellent interpersonal skills. * Anything else that managers deem necessary to assign in order to support the company’s mission, vision, and values.

jobs.title: Mid Market Account Executive - US
jobs.description: Sprinto is an **Autonomous Trust Platform** that centralizes trust requirements across **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.** Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve **raised** **$31\.8M** in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over **4,000 organizations across 75 countries**, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With **300\+ native integrations** and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports **200\+ global security standards natively**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. **Founded in 2020** by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. ### **Life as a Sprinter \-** Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. ### **The mission \-** You will own the **Mid\-Market** segment in the US as an individual contributor. This means building your territory from the ground up, identifying and prioritizing the right accounts, and running full\-cycle deals from first outreach to close without a playbook handed to you. Your buyers are Heads of Security, Directors of Engineering, Heads of Compliance, and VP\-level stakeholders at companies with 500 to 1,000 employees. Deals average $30K to $60K in ACV and you will be working a focused, high\-velocity account list. You will have founder\-level access and visibility, fast decisions, no bureaucracy, and a direct line to the people building the product. ### **Where you'll leave your mark?** * Own a **greenfield enterprise territory** in the US from day one, building your pipeline from scratch with no inherited book of business. * Close net new **mid\-market logos** in the **$30K to $60K ACV range**, targeting companies with 500 to 1,000 employees across your defined territory. * Run full\-cycle, **multi\-threaded deals** with buying committees that include **CISOs, VP Engineering, and Heads of Compliance** — not a single\-contact motion. * Build and work a focused account list, prioritizing accounts with a replicable system rather than volume\-based outreach. * Contribute directly to **shaping** what **mid\-market sales** looks like at Sprinto in the US — your wins, losses, and learnings will inform the playbook. * **Collaborate** with **Solutions Consultants** and **SDRs** to bring the right support into deals at the right moment while owning the relationship and the close. * Forecast with discipline and accuracy, managing a pipeline that reflects reality rather than optimism. ### **The kind of builder we're looking for \-** * A background at a **challenger brand** in **cybersecurity, GRC, compliance, or security\-adjacent SaaS** — somewhere the brand did not open doors for you and you built pipeline through outbound discipline and genuine buyer relationships. * A **track record** of carrying and **exceeding a quota** of **$700K or more** as an **individual contributor**, sustained across at least two consecutive years. * Experience selling **technical products** to **CISO, VP Engineering, or CTO buyers**, with the ability to hold a credible conversation about security workflows and compliance requirements without a pre\-sales engineer doing the heavy lifting. * A **focused account prioritization system** — you can explain exactly how you decide which accounts to go after, in what order, and why. * **Comfort with ambiguity** and a genuine appetite for the blank canvas — you have built from zero before and that is the environment where you do your best work. * Working knowledge of **MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, or Force Management** applied consistently. ### **Inclusion \& Diversity \-** At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The Senior AI Developer will work across the full stack of AI development, from data ingestion and model experimentation to application integration, orchestration, and deployment, and will collaborate closely with product teams, LLMOps engineers, designers, and mission stakeholders. Qualifications: * Ability to hold a position of public trust with the U.S. government. * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with at least 2\+ years focused on AI/ML, generative AI, or LLM\-driven application development. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar. * Demonstrated ability to design and develop production\-grade AI applications, including APIs, back\-end services, orchestration logic, and front\-end integrations (when needed). * Experience implementing RAG architectures, embeddings, vector stores, and context retrieval patterns. * Familiarity with multi\-agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering strategies, and advanced LLM interaction design. * Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including compute, serverless services, and security fundamentals for AI workloads. * Working knowledge of containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for AI\-based systems. * Experience with structured and unstructured data, document processing, and application integration with existing enterprise systems. * Understanding of responsible AI principles including safety, fairness, privacy, and model risk mitigation. * Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineering, design, and mission domains. * Proven experience mentoring teammates and raising the technical bar of development teams. * Local to the Washington, DC metro area preferred. jobs.title: Industrial Photographer
jobs.description: We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Industrial Photographer to join our vehicle engineering team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in supporting engineering projects by capturing high\-quality still photographs and high\-speed video footage of vehicles, components, and testing processes. This position requires technical expertise in photography and videography, a collaborative approach, and the ability to work in a dynamic industrial environment. **Key Responsibilities:** * Capture clear, high\-resolution still photographs of vehicles, prototypes, assemblies, and engineering tests for documentation, analysis, and presentation purposes. * Operate high\-speed video cameras to record vehicle tests and dynamic events, ensuring critical moments are captured for detailed engineering review. * Collaborate with engineers, technicians, and project managers to understand specific imaging requirements and adapt techniques to best support engineering objectives. * Set up and calibrate lighting, backdrops, and camera equipment in laboratory, workshop, and outdoor environments to achieve optimal image quality. * Edit, process, and catalog photographic and video assets, ensuring accurate labeling and secure storage for future reference and compliance needs. * Maintain and troubleshoot photographic and video equipment, including high\-speed cameras, lenses, lighting, and supporting hardware. * Ensure compliance with safety protocols and company policies during all photographic activities within industrial and test environments. * Support presentations, reports, and technical publications by providing visual content that effectively communicates engineering findings and solutions. Requirements: **Basic Qualifications:** * Minimum of an Associate's degree in photography, Visual Arts, Media Production, or a related field * Minimum of 2 years of proven experience in industrial, automotive, or technical photography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating still photographs and high\-speed video work. * Proficiency with DSLR/mirrorless cameras, high\-speed video cameras, and image/video editing software (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro). * Understanding of vehicle engineering processes, testing environments, and the unique challenges of industrial photography. * Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. * Strong communication and teamwork abilities. * Ability to work flexible hours and adapt to changing project requirements. * Physical ability to safely operate equipment and work in industrial settings (e.g., standing for long periods, lifting equipment, working outdoors). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in photography, Visual Arts, Media Production, or a related field * Experience with specialized imaging techniques such as time\-lapse, macro, and infrared photography. * Familiarity with data security and digital asset management practices. * Background in engineering, automotive testing, or related technical fields.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Mechanical Engineer - Tool Engineer
jobs.description: The primary role of the Manufacturing Mechanical Engineer is to participate within an Engineering team to develop and launch processes that meet all objectives for safety, quality, delivery, and cost for both new model (NM), non\-new model (NNM), and adaptation programs. This position supports all Manufacturing Engineering functions for North America powertrain battery tray/frame, casting, components, engine, and transmission programs. Main responsibilities include: * Perform assessments for process changes and related investment requirements for cost studies * Understand engineering scope definition, Requests for Quotes (RFQ’s), sourcing, technical evaluations, design, manufacturing, and installation of air/mist/coolant collectors and filtration * Support and prioritize the Non\-New Model (NNM) powertrain programs requests and ensure that approved programs are completed on time and within budget * Support all New Model (NM) program’s facilities aspects including site preparation and machine installation * Support flow activities on programs ensuring successful implementation and tracking of the Iron Triangle (Scope, Timing, and Cost) * Participate in the implementation of Stellantis Industrial System (SIS) methodology, supporting all activities including deployment of advanced SPW tools and guide systematic root cause problem solving methods to attack risks * Development/improvement of process and equipment standards related to facilities infrastructure. * Manufacturing Plants located in Dundee, Michigan (MI), Trenton, Michigan (MI), Kokomo, Indiana (IN) and Saltillo, Mexico (MX); Transmission Plants in Kokomo and Tipton, Indiana (IN); Casting Plants in Kokomo, Indiana (IN) and Etobicoke, Ontario (ON), Toledo, Ohio (OH), while maintaining a relationship with the Global CoC initiatives. * Drive standardization across plants in all regions **Basic Qualifications:** * High school diploma or GED and 3 years of experience in engineering or a related technical field * Ability to work and interact with all levels of the organization * Strong oral, written, presentation and organizational skills * Ability to translate technical data and analysis into an executive summary format for presentation in easily understandable formats * Ability to embrace cross\-functional teams responsible for developing, specifying, building, and launching powertrain manufacturing processes * Knowledge of advanced problem\-solving skills and ability to manage data analysis to identify root causes and attack them to closure * Knowledge of cost studies and strategic planning * Microsoft Office intermediate or advance knowledge **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or technical equivalent * Master’s degree in Engineering or equivalent * Preferred 5 or more years manufacturing experience, Powertrain Manufacturing experience a plus * Preferred 5 or more years’ experience in program management or multi\-tasking environment

Design \& Backlog Ownership \- Own the CMS/product backlog, including design\-related work: mockups, prototypes, design specs, and UI/UX tickets — ensuring it's the single source of truth for design and development work. \- Build and iterate on prototypes and mockups directly in \*\*Figma\*\* and \*\*Claude Design\*\*, translating high\-level concepts into concrete, testable design artifacts. \- Create and refine user stories with clear acceptance criteria, including visual/interaction specifications derived from Figma files, so design intent survives the handoff to engineering. \- Prioritize backlog items based on business value, design quality, technical feasibility, risk, and dependencies. \- Ensure design and backlog items are "ready" — sufficiently detailed, reviewed, and approved before entering a sprint. \- Manage design dependencies across teams (design system, front\-end, other product squads) to minimize roadblocks. \#\# III. Stakeholder Communication \& Collaboration \- Serve as the primary point of contact for design\- and product\-related inquiries from internal (sales, marketing, support, leadership) and external (customers, partners) stakeholders. \- Present design concepts, prototypes, and progress — using Figma and Claude Design artifacts — to communicate direction clearly to non\-design audiences. \- Gather and synthesize feedback from customer support, sales, user testing, and analytics to inform design and product decisions. \- Facilitate design workshops and critique sessions to gather requirements, validate concepts, and align stakeholders around a direction. \- Manage competing priorities and expectations among stakeholders, balancing design quality against timeline and scope. \#\# IV. Development Team Collaboration \- Act as the voice of the customer and the champion of design quality throughout the development lifecycle. \- Be available to the development team to clarify design intent, answer questions, and make timely decisions on backlog items. \- Actively participate in refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. \- Review completed work against both functional acceptance criteria and design fidelity (comparing shipped work to the Figma/Claude Design source of truth) before accepting. \- Foster a collaborative environment between design, product, and engineering. \#\# V. Product \& Design Performance \- Define and track KPIs relevant to design quality and product success — engagement, conversion, usability metrics, load speed, accessibility compliance, and SEO performance. \- Analyze usage data and A/B test results to identify where design changes could improve outcomes. \- Monitor user feedback and support tickets for recurring usability or design issues. \- Continuously identify opportunities to improve usability, visual quality, and overall experience. \- Support product launches and post\-launch design iteration in partnership with marketing and sales. \#\# VI. Domain Expertise \- \*\*Hands\-on proficiency with Figma\*\* (prototyping, components, design systems, developer handoff) and \*\*Claude Design\*\* for rapid concepting, mockups, and iteration using our design systems. \- Solid understanding of web development technologies relevant to design handoff/ \- Strong grounding in UX/UI principles — information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, and accessibility (WCAG) and a11y based design frameworks. \- Awareness of performance, security, and scalability considerations as they intersect with design decisions. \#\# Requirements \- Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role with significant design ownership. \- Demonstrated portfolio or work history showing hands\-on use of Figma; familiarity with AI\-assisted design tools (Claude Design or similar) is a strong plus. \- Strong written and verbal communication skills for translating design intent across technical and non\-technical audiences. \- Based in or willing to work from our \*\*Denver, CO\*\* office during normal business hours. \#\# Nice to Have \- Background in real estate technology, MLS platforms, or B2B SaaS. \- Experience with design systems and Figma component libraries at scale. \- Familiarity with agile/Scrum ceremonies and backlog tools, or any experience in a software factory / high speed prototype to launch enterprise. Pay: $67,193\.00 \- $73,248\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Experience: * Product Ownership: 2 years (Required) * Product Design: 3 years (Required) Ability to Commute: * Denver, CO 80222 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Industrial Control Panel Electrical Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Step Into the Role** ====================== From your first week, you’ll take ownership of the full lifecycle of industrial control panel design. Your mornings might start in EPLAN refining schematics and layouts; by afternoon, you’re selecting breakers, fuses, drives, transformers, and rectifiers, confirming coordination and wire sizing, and syncing with fabrication partners to turn your designs into reality. You’ll set test plans for hipot, insulation resistance, and functional validation, and work side\-by\-side with mechanical, manufacturing, and electrical teammates to ensure reliable, compliant builds. **What You’ll Own** ------------------- * End\-to\-end design of industrial control panels aligned to NEC (NFPA 70\) and UL 508A. * Creation of complete schematics, panel layouts, and detailed BOMs in EPLAN or equivalent tools. * Component selection covering connectors, harnesses, branch circuit protection devices (breakers, fuses), and power conversion equipment (drives, transformers, rectifiers). * Specification for high\-voltage systems up to 600V AC and 2000V DC. * Vendor partnership and oversight with third\-party panel fabrication shops from concept through acceptance. * Definition and supervision of high\-voltage test procedures: hipot, insulation resistance, and functional tests. * Collaboration with mechanical engineering on enclosures, thermal management, and seamless system integration. * Participation in DFMEA to uncover failure modes and drive mitigation strategies. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field with 5\+ years’ relevant experience; or Master’s with 3\+ years. * Proficiency with EPLAN or similar panel design software. * Proven design experience aligned with NEC and UL 508A requirements. * Hands\-on high\-voltage testing expertise and strict adherence to safety protocols. * Deep knowledge of branch circuit protection coordination, wire sizing, and power conversion systems. * Vendor management experience across design, fabrication, and acceptance milestones. * Familiarity with PLM platforms (e.g., Arena, Teamcenter), product development tools (e.g., Jira), and requirements management (e.g., Jama). * Ability to operate independently with minimal supervision. ### **Preferred** * Background with a UL 508A Recognized Panel Shop or experience with UL listing processes. * NFPA 70E certification or demonstrated arc flash study experience. * Industry exposure: industrial automation, EV charging infrastructure, energy storage, or semiconductor equipment. * Experience using ETAP or similar tools for branch protection coordination studies. **Technical Strengths** ----------------------- * 120/208/240/480 Voltage Systems * Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) * Mechanical Design \& Engineering and blueprint interpretation * EPLAN and comparable ECAD tools **Tools \& Platforms You’ll Use** --------------------------------- * CAD: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Catia, Pro\-E / Creo, Siemens NX * Automation: Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) * Lifecycle \& Collaboration: Arena, Teamcenter, Jira, Jama **Standards \& Voltages** ------------------------- You’ll engineer to NEC (NFPA 70\) and UL 508A, and work confidently across 120/208/240/480 V systems as well as up to 600V AC and 2000V DC.

jobs.title: Tech Lead/Manager, Scientific Data Engineering
jobs.description: TetraScience is a Scientific Data and AI company with a mission to radically improve and extend human life. TetraScience combines the world's only open, purpose\-built, and collaborative scientific data and AI cloud with deep scientific expertise across the value chain to accelerate and improve scientific outcomes. TetraScience is catalyzing the Scientific AI revolution by designing and industrializing AI\-native scientific data sets, which it brings to life in a growing suite of next generation lab data management products, scientific use cases, and AI\-based outcomes Our core values are designed to guide our behaviors, actions, and decisions such that we operate as one. We are looking to add high\-performance team members that authentically and unconditionally embrace our values: * Transparency and Context \- We trust our people will make the right decisions and overcome any challenges when given data and context. * Trust and Collaboration \- We believe there can only be trust when there is transparency. We are committed to always communicating openly and honestly. * Fearlessness and Resilience \- We proactively run toward challenges of all types. We embrace uncertainty and we take calculated risks. * Alignment with Customers \- We are completely committed to ensuring our customers and partners achieve their missions and treat them with respect and humility. * Commitment to Craft \- We are passionate missionaries. We sweat the details, as the small things enable the big things. * Equality of Opportunity \- We seek out the best of the best regardless of gender, ethnicity, race, or age; We seek out those who embody our common values but bring unique and invaluable perspectives, talents, and advantages. **What You Will Do** You will be leading a team of Scientific Data Engineers (SDE) and helping build Tetra Data and productizable solutions, which is the foundation of the Data Engineering layer. We are looking for a data engineering leader who is experienced, hands\-on, and can also provide mentorship to junior team members. As a tech lead/manager, you should be comfortable managing engineering tasks, leading internal design sessions, implementing solutions, and driving projects to final production releases. You will work directly with cross\-functional teams like Product Managers, Scientific Business Analysts, and Solution Architects to gather business and data design objectives, resulting in production\-based solutions. You will be a team\-focused leader, have excellent data engineering skills, supervise and collaborate on project executions, and have a high commitment to customer success by delivering mission\-critical implementations. Our success is defined by collaboration. You will have tremendous support to achieve your objectives, from a variety of teams, both internal and external. * Manage a team of SDEs. Supervise their career growth and performance. * Work with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements, gather insight into potential positive outcomes, recommend potential outcomes, and build a solution based on consensus. * Take ownership of building data models, prototypes, and solutions that drive customer success. * Use LLM to build comprehensive data schemas and parsers for pre\-clinical data (main data sources: R\&D lab instruments, manufacturing, CRO, CDMO, ELN, LIMS) with various data formats: .xlsx, .pdf, .txt, .raw, .fid, many other vendor binaries * Extract reusable schema components and parsing functions, and productize them into Python libraries * Build high\-quality data pipelines with full unit test and integration test coverage to produce high\-fidelity data * Build data applications, reports, and dashboards using React, Streamlit, Jupyter notebook, etc. * Drive value for the customers \- verify the solution fulfills their requirements and provides value * Quality gatekeeper: design with quality backed by unit tests, integration tests, and utility functions. * Promote team\-wide process/technology improvements on product quality and developer experience * Rally the team to finish Agile Sprint commitments. Actively surfacing team inefficiencies and striving to resolve them. * Driven by results. Have the pragmatic urgency to resolve blockers, unclear requirements, and make things happen. **Requirements** * 10\+ years of building solutions as a Data Engineer or similar fields * 10\+ years working in Python and SQL with a focus on data * Experience manaing engineering teams with five or more direct reports. * Experience leading projects, managing requirements, and handling timelines * Experience managing multiple customer\-focused implementation projects across cross\-functional teams, building sustainable processes, and managing delivery milestones * Experience with data plotting dashboarding tools like React and/or Streamlit is strongly preferred * Experience working with pre\-clinical data and lab scientists is strongly preferred * Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the confidence to take control of project delivery. * Quickly understand a highly technical product and effectively communicate with product management and engineering. **Benefits** 100% employer paid benefits for all eligible employees and immediate family members. 401K. Unlimited paid time off (PTO). Company paid Life Insurance, LTD/STD. The salary range for this position is $180K\-$230K USD. The salary range posted reflects our target baseline for this role. Final compensation is determined by a thorough evaluation of factors including the candidate’s specific experience, localized market data, and internal team equity. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship
